stepAnswer: Typical calories consumed through food j per serving size
stepBody:
Jennie modifies the featurization slightly; instead of setting all dummy features of all foods eaten by an individual on that day to $$1$$ and not eaten to $$0$$, we set the dummy features of all foods eaten to the number of servings they ate. We construct a design matrix X of shape $${10}^6$$ by $$4$$ that contains only this featurization to predict the total calories in an individual's lunch using ordinary least squares. What does the optimal coefficient $$\hat{	heta}_j$$ represent?

A. Typical calories consumed through food j per day
B. Typical calories consumed through food j per serving size
C. Typical calories consumed by person j per day
D. Typical calories consumed by person j per serving size
choices: Typical calories consumed through food j per day
Typical calories consumed through food j per serving size
Typical calories consumed by person j per day
Typical calories consumed by person j per serving size
Typical total calories consumed per day across all foods
